topology: 2 nodes x 1 rank, OSU Micro-Benchmarks 7.5 osu_acc_latency and osu_fop_latency on a 4-byte MPI_INT window, --mca osc ucx
golden: none — assertions only, and the parameters below are command-line arguments rather than anything a capture produced.
workload_note:
`c/mpi/one-sided/osu_acc_latency.c` and `osu_fop_latency.c` from OSU 7.5, run as `-m 4:4 -T MPI_INT -i 20 -x 5`.

WHY THESE ARGUMENTS. Both benchmarks default to WIN_ALLOCATE + FLUSH (osu_acc_latency.c:39-41, osu_fop_latency.c:46-47), so run_acc_with_flush / run_fop_with_flush execute. acc computes `count = size / dtype_size` = 4/4 = 1 and issues ONE MPI_Accumulate(MPI_SUM) per iteration; fop has no size loop at all and issues one MPI_Fetch_and_op(MPI_SUM) of one element per iteration. `-i 20 -x 5` therefore gives exactly 25 four-byte one-sided operations from rank 0, in one window, in each benchmark. `-T MPI_INT` is accepted only because these two benchmarks set options.show_validation = 1 before process_options, which is what puts `T:` into the one-sided option string (osu_util.c:601); osu_put_bw cannot take it and does not need it.

WHY FOUR BYTES IS THE POINT. UCX's atomic doors take 4- and 8-byte operands and nothing else. MPI_INT is the smallest datatype that a hardware atomic can carry, so this is the arm in which MPI_Accumulate and MPI_Fetch_and_op CAN reach ucp_atomic_post / ucp_atomic_fetch_nb. The contrast arm in job.sbatch runs osu_fop_latency at its default MPI_CHAR — one byte, which no UCX atomic supports — and the difference between the two captures is the study's claim-3 result. That arm is deliberately NOT judged by these assertions: a refused atomic is the expected outcome there, and asserting success over it would be asserting that the knob does nothing.

ATOMIC_OPS IS A FLOOR, NOT A CEILING, in the assertions. OpenMPI's own window locking uses 64-bit fetch-and-add and compare-and-swap on its state window, so the atomic table is not the workload's alone; the workload's own operations are separated from MPI's by operand width (4 bytes against 8), which is a property of the datatype on the command line rather than of anything observed.

PRE-REGISTERED ALTERNATIVE, stated in PREDICTION.md before the run: osc_ucx_acc_single_intrinsic is off by default in OpenMPI, and with it off these calls may take the generic path — accumulate lock, ucp_get_nbi, local compute, ucp_put_nbi — in which case the workload's operations never reach the atomic doors and atomics_reached_the_atomic_doors goes red. That failure would be a fact about OpenMPI, not a defect in comshu, and the capture showing a lock-get-put where the MPI standard says `accumulate` is itself the finding.
